articles.summary: EAU CLAIRE, Wis., July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Citizens Community Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: CZWI), the parent company of CCFBank N.A. (the “Bank” or “CCFBank”), today reported earnings of $1.1 million and earnings per diluted share of $0.11 for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to $3.8 million and earnings per diluted share of $0.39 for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, and $3.3 million and $0.33 earnings per diluted share for the quarter ended June 30, 2025
articles.title: Citizens Community Bancorp, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Earnings of $0.11 Per Share; Board Approves Quarterly Dividend at $0.105 per Share
